_comment: Recorded model turns for `briefkasten demo gehaltsabrechnung`. The payslip agent first files the care insurance under the wrong category; the arithmetic check in its submit tool rejects it and the agent fixes it.

supervisor.text: I'll start by classifying the document.
It is a payslip, so it goes to the payslip specialist; the explanation is independent, so both run now.
The numbers add up after one correction. Now the critic checks the explanation.

input.notes: Explained your October payslip line by line; the numbers were checked and add up (gross 3,850.00 € → net 2,454.60 € → paid out 2,414.60 €). Check the church tax if you are no longer a church member.

input.reasoning: A monthly salary statement (Brutto/Netto-Bezüge) from the employer.

input.summary_en: This is your salary statement for October 2026 from Beispiel Software GmbH. You earned 3,850.00 € gross (salary plus 250.00 € overtime). After income tax, church tax and your share of social insurance, your net pay is 2,454.60 €. 40.00 € goes to your savings contract, so 2,414.60 € is transferred to your bank account.
key_points: Gross pay 3,850.00 €, including 250.00 € for 10 overtime hours.
Social insurance: 833.53 € (health, pension, unemployment, long-term care).
Net pay 2,454.60 €; paid out 2,414.60 € after the 40.00 € VWL savings payment.

worth_checking_en: Church tax (41.62 €) is deducted because your religion is recorded as 'rk'. If you have left the church, have your registration corrected.
Check that the 10 overtime hours match your own records.
